about: Real reads of kinlab-ai/kin taken on 2026-10-12 for export pull request #1848 and the squash it landed as on main, trimmed to the fields scripts/select-release-candidate.py reads. The main listings were read after main's own CI and Acceptance push runs had finished and keep every run created before 01:45Z, when main's CI concluded; the tests slice them back to the moment of landing. The RC Build runs are the two attempts the cut spent on 08d48c27 when the macOS arm64 leg hit its 90-minute bound, plus one concurrency cancel and one manual cancel for contrast. The head's tree was read from the git commits API and its ancestry from the compare API (merge base 57826486, behind by 0); the live selector reads both from git after fetching refs/pull/1848/head.
